items.name: Nutra Healthspan Summit 2026

links.sans_europe_2026: the day before, same venue: data/events/sans-europe-2026

items.to_check: The programme (sessions, speakers, times) is not on the event page yet; Nathan's screenshots of the event app would give it, as for SANS Europe.
items.added_by: Claude (from Nathan, 10 Nov 2026, and NutraIngredients' event page)
items.description: NutraIngredients' second Healthspan Summit, two days on nutrition for healthy ageing and longevity, held the day after SANS Europe at the same venue. Themes on the event page: state of the market; consumer insights; mitochondrial function and ageing; women's health; diagnostics, testing and wearables; the regulatory landscape; healthcare practitioners; investors and market success; cognition and ageing.

items.name: Sports & Active Nutrition Summit Europe 2026
items.to_check: The opening before 09:05, the 10:55-11:20 slot, 15:30-16:00 and any other Affiliation Hub breakouts were not in Nathan's programme screenshots; the 14:00 to 15:30 talks (Mark Evans, Sharon Madigan, the Balchem slot, Thomas Hal Robson-Kanu) have no recording beyond a 35-second clip of Mark Evans; the roundtables were not recorded.
items.description: NutraIngredients' one-day sports and active nutrition conference, a single day (9 November 2026), followed on 10 and 11 November by its Nutra Healthspan Summit at the same venue, filed as its own event (nutra-healthspan-summit-2026). Programme tracks: State of the Market, Fuelling Performance, Reconsidering Recovery, Weight Management; main room the Partnership Forum, breakouts in Affiliation Hubs.

items.name: Remedy Nutrafood CDMO Conference 2026
items.to_check: Dates are from a NutraIngredients report (22-23 October 2026), not confirmed by Nathan; city and venue of this edition (the first edition, April 2025, was in Gdansk), the programme, who attended for Vita Actives, and Nathan's slides, notes and contacts still to come.
items.added_by: Claude (from Nathan, 9 Nov 2026, and a NutraIngredients report of 3 Nov 2026)
items.description: A conference bringing local contract manufacturers (CDMOs) together with market innovators, run by the nutraceuticals consultancy Remedy. Launched in Gdansk in April 2025 (about 150 attendees), with a satellite event in Riga in June 2026; the 2026 edition ran on 22-23 October. Nathan attended and will share details.
